reviews.text:
This is a long review, but here’s the big idea: I think Hasani Davis is easily one of the best dog trainers in the country right now. We drove all the way from Arkansas to do the 5 week board and train because Hasani’s approach was unlike anything else we’d read about. We are tremendously happy with the experience and the results. As a result of the training, Monk (our dog) is calmer, more confident, and more resilient. Even better, we as Monk’s owners feel so much more capable and confident in our relationship with him. Training with Hasani is the best decision we have yet made for our dog and our family.

What sets Hasani apart from other dog trainers is that he works from the ground up, structuring your dog’s behavioral foundation rather than solely focusing on commands. This means that the dog learns to make good decisions even when you aren’t giving a cue. It means that you don’t need your dog to always be in command because their new baseline is neutral and calm.

Hasani focuses on structure rather than symptoms. Here’s an example. Monk used to freak out whenever someone came to our door and it became stressful to invite people over. Other trainers told us to put him in a “place” command or just meet people on the street. These suggestions responded to the symptom – barking at guests and rushing the door – but didn’t fix the root of the behavior – our dog’s nervousness about space and who controls it. Instead of these bandaid solutions, Hasani built up Monk’s pack drive – his confidence derived from being attuned to his social leaders (us). Now, when someone comes to the door we can put Monk in pack drive and he is calm and composed, all while making his own decisions. This is so cool to see! The reason he no longer barks and rushes the door isn’t because he’s in a command that prevents him from that behavior, it’s because he no longer feels the need to bark and rush the door because he derives security from his pack.

Being able to cue our dog’s switch into a pack mentality is just one of many tools Hasani gave us, which ultimately amount to a communication system. Hasani taught us how to work with our dog and clearly communicate with him. He gives you a toolkit, which empowers you to keep improving long after the training session is over. It means that when your dog has off-days or setbacks, you know how to respond and work through it as a team. Honestly, the most satisfying moments aren’t when Monk is being perfect, it’s when he’s struggling, because now we know how to work through it together. The other day I took Monk to a busy farmer’s market and at first he was overstimulated and distracted. I pulled off to the side and started doing some leash work with the dog like Hasani taught us. Within 2 minutes Monk was locked back in on me and I spent the rest of the morning at the market with him in a calm heel, indifferent to everything that was happening around us and focused on me.

One of our favorite things about Hasani is that he’s really good at communicating with humans, too. Hasani is direct, clear, and genuinely listens to your experience and perspective. I spent the first 6 months of raising a puppy saying “ugh I just wish I knew the right thing to DO” whenever frustrating moments arose, and with Hasani on our team we finally have the answers. As we picked up Monk from the last day of his board and train, Hasani said to us that Monk now had every skill he’d need for the rest of his life, baked in. All we have to do is keep the wheels greased. That is exactly true. Our dog left his training more confident, calmer, and more resilient, and we left with a road map, which finally took all of the second guessing out of dog training. We are now enjoying life to the fullest with Monk -- off leash hikes, eating on patios, adventures, all because Leash Drop Canine helped set us up for success. 10,000 stars for Hasani and his remarkable, professional team!

We cannot say enough great things about Hassani and his training program! The transformation we’ve seen in our Rottweiler puppy has been incredible.

He has made tremendous strides in his obedience, eye contact, responsiveness, and ability to take cues from us. But what has impressed us most is how much the training has changed our everyday life with him. Walking him is no longer stressful, we feel much more confident handling and communicating with him, and he has become an even more enjoyable member of our family.

The difference is noticeable to other people, too. Our friends genuinely enjoy being around him now and can appreciate him as the loving, well-mannered dog we knew he could be.

Hassani, as the owner and head trainer, has done an amazing job not only training our dog but also helping us build a better relationship with him.

If you have a strong or high-energy breed and want training that translates into real-life results at home, we highly recommend Hassani and his team. The investment has absolutely been worth it for our family.

We couldn’t be happier with our experience with Hasani and his staff at Leash Drop Canine!

Our Bull Terrier, Kane, completed their 3-week Board and Train program beginning August 3rd, and the difference has been incredible. Before training, walking Kane could be challenging because he would pull on his leash and wasn’t always easy to manage. Since completing the program, he no longer pulls on his leash and is a much more well-behaved, structured, and manageable dog.

What really stood out to us was Hasani’s knowledge, patience, and genuine dedication to the dogs he works with. He took the time to understand Kane and helped give him the structure and training he needed while also giving us the tools to continue reinforcing what he learned at home.

We would absolutely recommend Hasani and the entire Leash Drop Canine team to anyone looking for professional dog training. They did an amazing job with Kane, and we are extremely happy with the results.

We will definitely be bringing Kane back in the future for advanced training and classes. Thank you, Hasani and the entire team, for taking such great care of Kane and helping him become the best version of himself!

Our experience with Drop Leash Canine LLC has been positive and impactful. We chose the dog boarding with training which included a safe environment for our dog, weekly training sessions on and off-site, and  support via instructional videos.

Our family, friends, and neighbors noticed how he was not as anxious and how well he responded to commands.

The results we received were priceless and will continue to improve with at home training that enforces the 5 week training our dog already completed.

If you want your canine to be well-trained by a professional that is passionate about the process and thorough with explanations, inquire about how Drop Leash Canine LLC can help you achieve your goals, you will be glad you did!

If there’s a stubborn dog breed, it’s the bull terrier. Our six-year-old Lester used to run the house and guard every corner. Guests, other dogs, new places, he thought everything belonged to him. But after working with Hasani, our home feels much more balanced.

Between May and June, Lester spent five weeks with Hasani at Leash Drop Canine. This week, Hasani came to our home for the first follow-up. The difference is amazing. Our walks are organized; Lester can play off-leash at the park, and he doesn’t chase every bike or squirrel anymore. He barely notices them now! At home, he has his own spot to relax and knows he needs to follow commands and do some training before playtime.

For us, LDC’s training works because the goal is to help you understand how your dog thinks. Hasani  teaches us how to communicate in ways Lester understands and comes to expect, which makes it much easier for us to connect. His advice is simple to follow and really works for the long term, as long as you stay committed to your dog!

Lester worked with three other trainers before Hasani. That alone says a lot; we wouldn’t think twice about working with Hasani again, and he will soon stay at LDC again for boarding while we are ooo. Thank you, Hasani. Lester says hi!

P.S. If you follow LDC on Instagram, you might remember Lester as the dog growling at Hasani’s hand on his first day of training. That’s not him anymore!

I cannot recommend Hasani enough!

When I sent my dog, Levi, to Hasani’s 3-week board and train program, he was only 4 months old. Levi was a very high-energy puppy who was extremely mouthy, constantly on the go, and struggled to relax. From the very beginning, Hasani gave me a clear game plan of what to expect throughout the training process and what goals we would be working toward.

Now, 2.5 months after Levi’s return, the results have been incredible. At just 7 months old, his obedience and behavior are at a very high level for his age. He has excellent recall, walks beautifully on leash, and knows several commands. One of the biggest changes has been his ability to settle and remain calm.

Since Levi returned home, I have also welcomed a child into my family, and his calmer demeanor and improved impulse control have made a huge difference. He is well-controlled around the baby and continues to show the stability and structure that Hasani helped build.

What really sets Hasani apart is that he didn’t just train my dog—he educated me as an owner. He took the time to teach me how to properly handle, communicate with, and guide Levi. I learned so much about dog behavior and realized there were many habits and mistakes I had been making without even knowing it.

Levi now lives a structured lifestyle and genuinely enjoys the daily training and engagement we do together. The support didn’t end when the board and train was over, either. Hasani provides follow-up home visits and continues to offer excellent knowledge, guidance, and support, especially when working through behaviors in different environments. His commitment to both the dog and owner goes far beyond the initial program.

I can’t thank Hasani enough for everything he has given our family. Levi is well on his way to becoming the best companion I could ask for, and I look forward to watching him continue to mature. If you’re looking for a trainer who truly cares, delivers results, and provides ongoing support, I highly recommend Hasani for any dog training needs, questions, or guidance.

Nothing short of incredible!! Seriously, though. I was initially skeptical, not because of Leash Drop or the owner, Hasani, but because I had previously sent my dog, Barksdale, to all sorts of training but nothing stuck. Even from the initial phone consultation with Hasani he explained to me the difference between bribing a dog and actual training. I was blown away because Hasani was absolutely right. Bribing is exactly what happened at all the other places I sent our dog to. We did the initial board and train and even doing just that was unbelievable with the transformation Barksdale went through; it was truly worth every penny. But for us the most crucial aspect was Hasani establishing the foundation in our dog so that we as the owners could continue everything he worked so hard to instill in Barksdale. We couldn't be happier with our experience to the point where strangers on the street will comment on how well behaved Barksdale is only for us to immediately refer them to Hasani at Leash Drop Canine. It's truly been such a positive experience and we plan to continue to send Barksdale to Hasani for the foreseeable future.

Hasani Davis of Leash Drop Canine has been a great trainer for us.We signed up for the 5-pack of private lessons after an initial behavior assessment for our 4-month-old adopted shepherd pup, Gertie. At the time, she was very reactive around other dogs and needed help building both confidence and basic manners.

After just five lessons, we’ve seen a clear improvement in her confidence and in how she responds to us. Hasani’s training style is structured, thoughtful, and effective — each exercise has a purpose, and when you consistently practice what he teaches, you see real progress.

He also emphasizes clear boundaries and expectations between dog and owner, which not only helped Gertie but made us more confident and capable handlers. We’re grateful for the strong foundation he’s helped us build.

We would absolutely sign up again for future training and enrichment with Hasani and recommend Leash Drop Canine to others looking for practical, results-driven support.

I am so glad I found Leash Drop Canine for my dog training. Hasani did an amazing job in just a short 5 weeks to help my dog become a whole new dog! Our dog is 2 years old, so she was very energetic and hard to control especially during walks, but now she is calmer and we can finally go on walks easier with her. The training has helped my kids be more comfortable and closer to the dog as she is able to be more relaxed in the living room and not have to be separated in the basement anymore. I feel more comfortable with training and building a stronger relationship with my dog and don’t have to be worried about her being too energetic around all the kids. My kids are very happy with the training and love being around her more now. I highly recommend anyone who wants to train their dog to use this company.

Omg there are no words to share the excellent service I received at Leash Drop Canine. I brought a 11mobth old hyper hard headed Yorkie who I had trained with bad habits. My dog only rode in stroller ate in a high chair at dinner barked at every dog and person ,rever respected boundaries and refused to be house broken. I started with the private lessons which I loved and I learned quickly that I needed the training not my baby.  I progressed to the 5 week boarding
Program which was phenomenal.  I accept the challenges to follow thru with what she has learned. My Mytacle follows all commands, is as calm as my voice and a joy to be around.  HASSANI IS SO PATIENT no question is too stupid and his customer service is excellent. Worth every penny I spent and then some. I found him on Facebook and I have no regrets

I strongly recommend Leash Drop Canine dog training for all dog owners. I have taken previous training courses, but none of the classes I have taken previously come close to the individual instruction I had with Hasani Davis.

Why Leash Drop Canine?:

I learned how to interact with my dog that so I have a well trained dog that respects me, my personal space and me as a leader

I learned how to communicate with my dog so that my expectations are clear (command, body movement and correction, if needed)

I learned the difference between an obedient dog that can follow a command and a well trained dog

I learned the goal is to build in my dog good habits and manners

Regardless of whether he is working with your dog or someone else’s, at Leash Drop Canine you are having a constant learning experience.

If you have a puppy and want to ensure a good foundation, a rambunctious teen, or an adult dog that needs fine tuning or is acting out, and you’re willing to do the work, Hasani Davis at Leash Drop Canine is your person.

I highly recommend Leash Drop Canine!

I can’t believe I haven’t written a review yet. I’ve been using Leash drop for years with my two dogs and recommend Hasani to everyone, he’s able to do what others can’t. Grateful he offers boarding now which also refreshes my dogs on their training. His services are just above and beyond.

Me and my partner adopted our mastiff mix Toby a year ago and try as we might he still had bad habits we couldn't work out (jumping and mouthy). I knew we needed someone to teach us how to communicate especially now since we're expecting. A family member, who is a Bridgeport resident sent me Leash Drop's website.

After talking to Hasani through phone and email we decided the Board and Train was the way to go for us. Naturally it was hard being away from Toby but I knew he would learn a lot and so would we.

The experience was AMAZING. Toby is better equipped at navigating the human world and we're getting better at navigating dog world. Hasani provides all the tools you need to build a better relationship with your pup.

We enrolled our 7-month-old GSD, Ares, in the Level 2 Board & Train program—not because he had behavioral issues, but to give him a strong, well-structured foundation for life. After extensive research, we chose Leash Drop Canine, and it was hands down the best decision we could have made.

Ares received phenomenal training, and just as importantly, we received excellent guidance as handlers through informative sessions and hands-on instruction. Communication throughout the five weeks was outstanding. Hasani was always available to answer questions and kept us informed, which gave us complete peace of mind knowing Ares was in great hands.

Ares came home with a noticeably improved demeanor, and we’re excited to continue building on the training Hasani provided. We highly recommend Leash Drop Canine to anyone looking for professional, knowledgeable, and truly caring trainers.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely outstanding dog training!

We brought our dog, Sinatra, to Leash Drop Canine at seven months old for a three-week board-and-train with Hasani, and the results were nothing short of remarkable. His training style is clear, structured, and genuinely effective — you can see the intention behind every exercise he teaches.

Throughout her stay, we received daily training videos that taught us how to continue the work at home in addition to receiving videos throughout the training that showed Sinatra’s progress. We visited his facility weekly to practice hands-on with her, and each session made it obvious how much time and care he puts into every dog he trains.

Sinatra came home with better manners, stronger recall, and a level of confidence we hadn’t seen before. Whether you have a small dog, a large dog, or a stubborn “good luck with that” type of dog, Hasani can handle it. Basic obedience or advanced off-leash training — he’s the real deal.

Worth every penny! The skills Sinatra learned are genuinely life-changing and will give her a safer, fuller, happier life. Couldn’t recommend Hasani more!

Hasani is incredible at what he does. We adopted our boy Ozzy (8 month old pit terrier mix) and within 3 weeks, we noticed he had some trauma and physical challenges (vision impairment) that we needed help navigating. He had extreme separation anxiety and was very frantic. We did the 3 weeks board and train. People aren’t kidding when they say their dogs come back a different dog. Hasani gave us the foundation and all we have to do is continue implementing what he taught us and Ozzy. Yes it was hard at times not seeing Ozzy except for the 2 times training with him and yes, you have to change how you interact with your dog but we feel that our relationship with him is 1000x better now. Our dogs deserve the training to help them navigate a human world. I’m so glad we did it.

Highly recommend Hasani! He's an exceptional dog trainer! Our dog Zoey came in with some behavioral issues - She was reactive towards squirrels and small rodents, had trouble listening around distractions, and was not leash trained.

From the first phone call, it was clear that Hasani had a good understanding of Zoey's problems and how to solve them. Zoey went into the 5 week board and training program and we were able to see progress within the second week. Zoey was more focused, responsive and also less scared of trying new things (like climbing up a flight of stairs). The weekly checkins, training sessions and videos were very helpful and informative tools. The sessions taught us how to communicate and how to maintain consistency of the training at home.

Overall I cannot say enough great things with our experience at Leash Drop Canine LLC. If you're looking for a trainer who delivers results with method and structure, then Hasani is your guy!

It has been life changing working with Hasani at Leash Drop Canine! My 2 year old pitbull was displaying various forms of reactivity which made the day to day very stressful. He had been to a couple different training programs prior to Leash Drop Canine but maintained these behaviors. After enrolling in Hasani’s Board and Train program, he came back a different dog! Highly recommend for all dog owners, regardless of the dog’s personality. Will definitely continue working with Hasani to maintain my dog’s progress and quality of life!

My pup was as willful as huskies could get. We tried training her at home, but I didn’t have the skills necessary to be successful. After boarding and training with Leash Drop Canine she is a completely different pup and I, now, have the skills necessary to effectively engage with her. Leash Drop Canine is a 10 out of 10, I would absolutely recommend them.

We came to Leash Drop Canine after it was recommended by an acquaintance I met at a party -- we bonded over reactive-dog life. And it can be a hard life! Our dog is a 1-year old cattle-dog mix (mixed with every type of high-energy, high-alertness shepherd), who struggled with recall, leash reactivity, recovering from outbursts, and staying engaged with us on walks whenever another dog or car passed. I say "she struggled," but Hasani had us quickly realizing that we were the ones struggling to guide our sweet, doesn't-know-any-better pup through it all. We did the 3-week board and train with Leash Drop/Hasani -- and it was SO worth the money to come back from it with both a dog and us owners feeling more confident and equipped for the rest of her (hopefully long) life. We were nervous that we were sending her to 'scared straight' school (lol), but please be assured that that's not the case. We got to come in to Leash Drop and see our dog's process halfway through her training, and train ourselves along the way. Hasani provided so many equally helpful and entertaining videos to get us smart for our dog's return. Like literally, some of the videos went platinum in our household, lol. Overall, I'd describe the process/Hasani/Leash Drop as extremely knowledgable about what dogs need AND what they need from their owners, and as a master of the importance of consistency. We learned an incredible amount about our role in the dog's improvements, a more empathetic view of why she was behaving in the ways she was, and the importance of structure, rules and boundaries in helping her trust us and ease out of her reactivity. You get out of this program what you put into it -- it's not just a magical drop-off where the dog comes back "fixed." You've got to be willing to learn and practice and maintain what you've learned -- but luckily, Hasani makes it so, so easy to do just that. We also appreciate the house calls/follow-ups and how quickly Hasani responded to all of our questions once the dog was home!

Hasani was at our home for less than  1 minute and got us and our Cody back on track. Hasani makes learning for our dog and us so easy. I would recommend Hasani to anyone in need of an “effective” trainer and teacher. 100%

Jaffa was a tough puppy; didn’t listen, very jumpy with people, very hard to walk on a leash, barking in his crate constantly & couldn’t be left alone for more than a few seconds. After sending him to training with Hasani for the initial 2 week training then the 5 week boarding, he’s a completely different dog. He is extremely obedient, is able to be off leash, is very confident and has done a complete 180. He is essentially the perfect dog now and I am so grateful to Hasani. There are so many friends of mine who sent their dogs to various popular training places in Chicago and Jaffa is one of the best trained dogs among them. I wouldn’t think twice about this and would reccomend him to EVERYONE. He takes such care in the dogs and the training, and you can see how passionate Hasani is about dogs and their relationship with their owners. I’ve learned so much and continue to be supported by him whenever I need. Worth every dollar!!!!

We had our 4 year old dog Floyd complete the 5 week board and train with Hasani and had a fantastic experience. Being involved with Floyd’s learning was probably the most important part and learning how to guide him confidently through different scenarios. That’s probably my main message to you - you have to be ready to change how you interact with your dog and what standards you hold them to. But if you’re committed, the progress will show.

All aspects of obedience, responsiveness and being non-reactive in different scenarios are so much better. Floyd’s loose leash and off-leash walks/hikes are fantastic. We’re calm, he’s calm, and everyone’s having a good time. There’s definitely things we need to keep working on together but the follow up sessions with Hasani are invaluable in ‘tuning up’ our skills.  We’ve all seen an improvement in our quality of life through this experience and would highly recommend! Thanks Hasani

Our stubborn terrier is now able to heel and can finally recall with Hasani's work. Follow up home sessions have also helped in reinforcing the lessons and figuring out what wrong messages I've been sending to him. We tried another board and train service and it didn't stick, so we are so thankful. Also, Hasani does offer fair priced boarding after the board/train program so that's appreciated as well as we were paying more for questionable services and I know he'd keep up the regimen. My dog is happy (waggy tails) to see him every time or go into his training facility so I think my puppers approves. Only regret is that I wish we had gone earlier during the puppy phase so we didn't have to unlearn bad habits. Please never move out of the City. Thanks again.

We brought our 11 month old foster-turned-adopted pup to Leash Drop Canine. She was terrified; we could not take her on a walk because she was scared of people, cars...you name it.  She was also starting to show aggression with people outside our immediate family; we weren't sure what to do!  She went for the 5 week program, which was obviously needed.  It's still a lot of work to continue her training at home, but we've seen so much improvement in her and we wouldn't have been able to do it without this program. Also learning we, the pups parents, needed as much training as she did!!  And they are great with that! Providing weekly training with her while in the program, lots of helpful videos, directions on how to continue training at home and always answering questions quickly (even on weekends).  We are so happy to see our pup's progress, building her (and our) confidence.  THANK YOU!

We can't recommend this training highly enough; it was truly a game changer for us and our dog. We enrolled in the 5-week training program, and our dog, Hibiki, came back noticeably calmer and more disciplined, and our walks now so much more enjoyable; no more pulling, lunging, or reactivity.

It was difficult having her away from us, only seeing her once a week, but it was absolutely worth it. She now listens to us and follows commands consistently. One of our biggest concerns going in was whether her sweet disposition would change with the structure and discipline this program provides—but she’s still her same lovable self, just with some wonderful improvements.

Hasani, the dog trainer, is incredibly professional. Our sessions with him were informative and supportive. He took the time to answer all our questions and genuinely listened to our concerns. His training method is rooted in basic psychology, which he explained clearly, offering relatable examples that made it easy to understand and apply.

The training wasn’t just for Hibiki—it was also for us, as her owners. Hasani gave us clear, actionable instructions on how to help our dog become the best version of herself. He was firm yet kind with her, providing the discipline and structure she had been missing—just like the boundaries you'd give to a human toddler.

Hibiki developed a very sweet bond with Hasani. When we picked her up, she actually seemed a little sad to leave his side, and she was visibly excited when she saw him again later. That connection speaks volumes about the trust and care he builds with the dogs he trains.
Thank you!
Great trainer — super patient and knows what he’s doing. My dog’s behavior changed so much after the sessions. Definitely recommend

I can’t say enough good things about Hasani! From day one, he’s been professional, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable. We did the board and train program for both of my dogs. They responded to his training methods almost immediately, and I saw real improvement in behavior week after week. Hasani doesn’t just train your dog—he teaches you how to build a stronger bond with your pet. He tailors each session to fit your dog’s personality and your specific goals, which made a huge difference. If you’re looking for a reliable, effective, and genuinely passionate trainer, Hasani is the one. Highly recommend!

Hasani and team are pure magic! The amount of work they put in with the pups, and most importantly, the humans, is above and beyond perfect. The clear and concise directions Hasani uses make it extremely easy to keep training and progressing. I highly recommend the Board and Train program for all dogs, regardless of level. It truly makes the humans better owners. Thank you, Hasani!

I am so happy we sent our dog Bodhi here! We have a puppy cane corso, he’s almost one and I feel more confident with taking him on walks with the loose leash training. I’m slowly starting to try off leash train with him and I see so much progress in such little timing.
I definitely will recommend leash drop canine to family and friends!

Our dog Milo came back after his 3 week training with no leash pulling, started stopping at doors, was more responsive and overall much better behaved with better manners. Hasani taught us exactly how to be good dog parents and how to keep his training up while keeping Milo happy and engaged. His follow up visits are such a great addition as it allowed us to ask questions we wouldn’t have realized without having been home first. Couldn’t recommend him more!

Just like most people, we got a dog and had no clue what we were in for. My husband had always wanted a dog. The idea of having a fun, loyal companion and protector sounded great to him.

However, he never considered the other important aspects, such as structure and discipline.

For months, there was little to no structure for our Rottweiler. We had no idea what we were doing because many of the online videos don’t explain what a dog should actually be doing throughout the day.

So, we let our dog roam around the house, and he got into everything like eating shoes, jumping on counters, sitting on the couch, chewing up important paperwork, and more. Not to mention, he started to bite and bump on people. He was only playing, but he didn’t understand his own strength, which could seriously hurt someone.

Eventually, I had enough. I was scared he might accidentally hurt our daughter during playtime.

We decided to send our dog to Hasani for obedience school. Although it was tough not having him at home for those few weeks, it was absolutely worth it. Hasani sent us regular progress videos, and there were scheduled visitations so we could practice what our dog was learning.

During one of our visits, we saw our dog doing things we never thought possible especially considering how little structure he had before. He was sitting calmly on a cot with other dogs and didn’t move until Hasani gave the command.

Hasani taught us the correct way to walk our dog and how to use the leash to correct his behavior. After picking our dog up from boarding, it honestly felt like we had a new dog.

Once we got home, there were a few things our dog tried to revert back to—for example, getting off the cot without permission. But Hasani stayed in touch, checking in and telling us exactly what to do to correct those behaviors.

A few weeks after board and training, Hasani came for a home visit. Our dog immediately recognized him and was so happy to see him. I was amazed at how our dog behaved doing things we were still struggling with didn’t happen at all while Hasani was present.

It reminded me of how some kids act out at school but behave perfectly when their parents are around. That’s exactly what it felt like. It was as if Hasani and our dog had their own language and our dog followed every single command without hesitation.

To sum it up: Hasani is worth every penny! He’s incredible and provides so many tools, resources, and hands-on support. Honestly, I wish he worked with kids too; I’d send my daughter there in a heartbeat! (Just kidding)

We can’t thank Hasani enough for the incredible work he did with our German Shepherd, Scooby-Doo. From day one, Hasani brought professionalism, patience, and a deep understanding of canine behavior that made all the difference.

Scooby was energetic, strong-willed, and sometimes a handful—but Hasani approached every session with calm confidence and a clear plan. He tailored the training to Scooby’s personality and helped us as owners understand how to reinforce the lessons at home. The results have been amazing—Scooby now walks calmly on leash, listens to commands, and is more focused and well-behaved in every situation.

What truly sets Hasani apart is his genuine love for dogs and his ability to communicate clearly with both pets and people. Training with him was not only effective but also a great experience that strengthened the bond between us and our pup.

If you’re looking for a dedicated, knowledgeable, and outstanding trainer, Hasani is the one. Thanks to him, our Scooby-Doo is living up to his potential—and we couldn't be happier!

It took all of 2 mins of walking our dog Bruce into leash drop to know we had made the right decision. Hasani helped explain the concepts and then showed us how to apply them and it worked right away. After the 3 week board and train we now feel more confident in our ability to train and correct bad behavior, and Bruce has learned so much. Highly recommend working with Hasani.

Cannot say enough about our amazing experience with sending our 11 month old Staffordshire to Hasani. He is definitely the dog whisperer! Couldn’t imagine trying to appropriately train our little guy without Hasani’s guidance. The 3-week training, instructional videos, and subsequent follow-ups in our home have been a game changer for us. Our puppy learned so much from Hasani during his time with him and he’ll equip you with the knowledge & tools to keep it going inside/outside of your home. We just can’t recommend him enough!

Hasani was such a pleasure to work with! He’s incredibly talented and taught us so much! Our 6 month old German Shepherd participated in the board and train program, when Kai came home all his fundamental training kicked in. He was a much more manageable dog, we were genuinely enjoying his company.

I walk several miles a day and I love having my dog so well behaved. No more pulling and no more uncontrolled walks. I couldn’t be happier! Thanks Leash Drop!
